description.value: Pan Pacific Vancouver is a five-star waterfront hotel situated atop the Canada Place convention centre and cruise ship terminal, offering panoramic views of Burrard Inlet and the North Shore mountains. It is one of Vancouver's flagship luxury properties, positioned at the heart of the downtown waterfront and steps from the seawall cycling network. The hotel caters primarily to business and leisure travellers, though its central location makes it a potential high-end base for cyclists exploring the region.
